metadata.description: Claude Code plugins by DazzleML: session logging, session backup, and conversation bookmarks.

plugins.name: bookmarks
plugins.description: Bookmarks and vim-style marks inside Claude Code conversations: mark a line, jump back, keep a reading position, browse your prompts, and let Claude cite earlier places as clickable links

plugins.name: session-logger
plugins.description: Real-time session logging, command history, and auto-naming for Claude Code

plugins.name: session-backup
plugins.description: Git-backed Claude Code session backup: auto-archives sessions before compaction and on session end
